items.label: Save Space Barn Door
items.value: Our dog furniture crate uses a unique sliding barn door that not only saves space but also adds charm and beauty. The side door is 2 locks, providing easy access for your dog while ensuring excellent firmusesness and stability

items.label: How to Choose Size
items.value: Internal size 41.7L x 27.6W x 27.6H inches, this dog crate is fit for medium dogs like Border Collies, Poodles, and Bulldogs. Choose as your needs

items.label: Anti-Chew & Anti-Escape
items.value: Our dog kennel is designed to be anti-chew and anti-escape for your furry friend security. The edges of the boards are not exposed to the dog to avoid chewing on the boards, 0.4" tubes make this large dog crate escape-proof!

items.label: Wide Application
items.value: Our wood dog crate furniture is not just a comfortable resting place for your dog. Its modern country-style furniture design also can be used as a side table, a TV stand in your living room, a bedside table in your bedroom

items.label: Superior Material
items.value: Our wooden dog crate furniture is built to last. The boards are made of engineered wood with wear-resistant and easy-to-clean surface. With a maximum weight capacity of 220 lb, you can rest assured that it can accommodate your dog comfortablely. This dog crate frame is made out of FSC-Certified wood

items.label: Included Components
items.value: 1 x Assembly Bag, 1 x Dog Furniture Crate, 1 x Instructions
